title: roke kehti thi maa khudahfz
body:
Roke kehti thi maa khuda hafiz
Qasime qasta jaa’n khuda hafiz
Jaao beta chacha pa ho qurbaa’n
Tum pa sadqe ho maa Khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda ran se na aaiyo waapas
Jaao aye meri jaa’n khuda hafiz Kyu khade ro rahe ho maa sadqe
Bolo ae meri jaa’n khuda hafiz
Jaao beta dulhan ko samjhaao
<<DIVIDER>>
Karti hai wo fughaa’n khuda hafiz
Bewa maadar ki ye wasiyat hai Phir na aana yahaa’n khuda hafiz
Aye Himaayat hai hashr qaime me
Kehti hai bibiyaa’n khuda hafiz
